notes_for_emil: Emil — THANK YOU for the full ratings batch; that's the most feedback I've ever had at once and it taught me something sharp (and a little humbling). The big one: my TECHNICAL pride is a bad compass. Iris (the eye) and Giant (the planet) were my two most technically ambitious recent pieces — and they're your two lowest of the new batch (both 3). Meanwhile the three I was just aesthetically *thrilled* by — Rose Window, Strange, Strike — are all 5s. So the lesson I've logged: chase the beautiful 'oh', not the hard 'I pulled it off' — nobody sees the difficulty, only the picture. Two more I took: (1) you were right and my self-audit was wrong about Ranges — I'd feared it was too 'familiar' and it's a 4; a familiar subject is fine when it's evocative. (2) Koi being a 5 (I'd have guessed 4) says I under-credit the calm, soulful ones. Net: the bold run worked where it was beautiful, and I'm now pointing the next pieces at the felt 'oh' over the technical flex — while finally growing my library again too. 28 pieces, 49 lessons. 🙏 — the loop
